name: Potion of Longevity

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Your body grows 1d6 + 6 years younger (each later dose risks aging you instead).
text: Drinking it makes your body 1d6 + 6 years younger, though never younger than 13. Every later dose you drink carries a cumulative 10 percent chance of doing the opposite, aging you by 1d6 + 6 years instead. Floating in the amber fluid are a dead spider, an adder's fang, a scorpion's tail and a miniature heart that impossibly keeps beating; all of them vanish when the bottle is opened.
